Outlet: Times of Israel daily liveblog, November 7, 2026 (Israel time, GMT+2) — WebFetch returned condensed renderings of Iran/Middle East entries only

12:28 am — Iran news agency reports 2 missiles struck Qeshm Island
"Two missiles struck Qeshm Island" with "no official information on possible damage," per Tasnim news agency. Local witnesses reported projectiles hitting the Suza area after aircraft sounds were heard.

2:48 am — US Central Command announces $20M reward for info on Iranian nuclear program
CENTCOM offered "$20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran's nuclear program," despite Trump's claims it was obliterated.

3:53 am — Qatar says mediation between US and Iran continuing
Qatar's PM stated "mediation efforts...are continuing to prevent the situation...from spiraling."

4:01 am — Iran negotiating with Russia for S-400 air defense system
Telegraph reports Iran pursuing S-400 deal with Russia. Iranian official stated the Islamic Republic is "optimistic" Putin will approve the sale.

4:24 am — Trump says US launched 'minor' strikes on Iran
Trump described military action as "minor," stating forces "knocked out...a little bit of an anti-aircraft device...in about 15 minutes."

4:25 am — Iranian military claims it's now 'stronger' than at start of war
Iranian army spokesman Mohammad Akraminia stated forces "are stronger than they were at the beginning of the war" with "greater motivation."

7:25 am — Saudi-led coalition says it downed Houthi cruise missile fired at Riyadh
Coalition intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile heading toward the Saudi capital.

12:37 pm — Saudi strikes in Sanaa kill 11, including women and children
Houthi Saba agency reported "11 citizens...martyrdom...women and children" in Al-Shariyah area strikes.

12:40 pm — Oil tanker catches fire after hitting naval mine in Strait of Hormuz
Iran's navy reported an oil tanker caught fire after hitting a naval mine in eastern Strait of Hormuz.

1:27 pm — Bessent reaches out to China to help end Iran war
Treasury Secretary contacted China to use influence with Tehran. China subsequently reached out to Iran.

1:57 pm — Trump advisers told him he has until new Congress to restart major Iran operations
Officials briefed Trump before midterms that major operations should restart before January congressional swearing-in.

2:15 pm — Toll of Saudi strikes on Sanaa rises to 22
Houthi media reported death toll reached "22 citizens...most...children and women" with "30" wounded.
